Pipeline must validate all planned pair and cell stems before comparison bootstrap or any rendering, using production naming helpers.
Actual384 test hardcodes a machine-specific live report path and skips elsewhere; preserve actual inventory proof in evidence and use synthetic portable CI fixtures.
